params.name: Fields
params.doc: The fields to render, in order.

params.name: Model
params.doc: The bound record; each field's Get reads it, each commit calls Set then ModelChanged.

params.name: ModelChanged
params.doc: Raised after a field commits (the model was updated through Set, or SetAsync succeeded). A handler on the parent re-renders it and this group: Get, When, Disabled and HelpWhen are read again.

fieldMembers.name: Hint
fieldMembers.doc: The line under the control.

fieldMembers.name: Required
fieldMembers.doc: The field must have a value.

fieldMembers.name: Placeholder
fieldMembers.doc: The control's placeholder.

fieldMembers.name: AutoComplete
fieldMembers.doc: The autofill token of a text, password, email, tel or url control, for example off, new-password or email; other kinds ignore it.

fieldMembers.name: Min
fieldMembers.doc: The minimum of the control, as text.

fieldMembers.name: Max
fieldMembers.doc: The maximum of the control, as text.

fieldMembers.name: Step
fieldMembers.doc: The step of the control, as text.

fieldMembers.name: MinLength
fieldMembers.doc: The minimum length of the control's text.

fieldMembers.name: MaxLength
fieldMembers.doc: The maximum length of the control's text.

fieldMembers.name: Pattern
fieldMembers.doc: The pattern the control's text must match.

fieldMembers.name: Rows
fieldMembers.doc: The rows of a textarea; the control's own default when unset.

fieldMembers.name: Free
fieldMembers.doc: A combobox accepts the typed text itself as its value.

fieldMembers.name: Mode
fieldMembers.doc: A combobox field's mode: "select" makes it a styled select (a button that opens the list, no typing); unset, or "autocomplete", types to filter.

fieldMembers.name: Span
fieldMembers.doc: The field fills the whole row of a multi-column group.

fieldMembers.name: ColumnSpan
fieldMembers.doc: The columns of a multi-column group the field takes (2 or 3); it sits in one column when the group is narrow. Span fills the whole row.

fieldMembers.name: HideLabel
fieldMembers.doc: Hides the label visually and keeps it as the control's accessible name.

fieldMembers.name: Format
fieldMembers.doc: An input kind's format; "money" shows the number as currency while the value stays the plain number.

fieldMembers.name: Decimals
fieldMembers.doc: Fraction digits of the money format.

fieldMembers.name: Currency
fieldMembers.doc: The ISO 4217 currency code of the money format.

fieldMembers.name: Locale
fieldMembers.doc: The BCP 47 locale of the money format.

fieldMembers.name: WhenExpr
fieldMembers.doc: A declarative condition the element evaluates against the live committed values as the user edits, with no server round trip: the field shows while it is true, e.g. "status == 'paid' && amount > 100" (field keys, 'text' and number literals, == != < <= > >=, in [a, b], !, && and ||; no function calls). The typed When still runs once per load; use this one for what must follow the user's edits.

fieldMembers.name: DisabledExpr
fieldMembers.doc: A declarative condition (see WhenExpr): the control is disabled while it is true.

fieldMembers.name: ReadonlyExpr
fieldMembers.doc: A declarative condition (see WhenExpr): the control is read-only while it is true.

fieldMembers.name: RequiredExpr
fieldMembers.doc: A declarative condition (see WhenExpr): the field is required while it is true.

fieldMembers.name: LabelWhenExpr
fieldMembers.doc: A declarative conditional text the element evaluates against the live values as the user edits: `cond ? 'text' : cond ? 'text' : other`, where a value is a 'text' or another field's key (that field's value), e.g. "status == 'paid' ? 'Paid on' : due". The first true condition's text is the label; an empty answer keeps Label. The typed LabelWhen still runs once per load.

fieldMembers.name: HelpWhenExpr
fieldMembers.doc: A declarative conditional text (see LabelWhenExpr) for the help tooltip beside the label; an empty answer keeps Help (no tooltip when that is empty too). The typed HelpWhen still runs once per load.

specMembers.name: SetAsync
specMembers.doc: An async commit (build it with Async): run instead of Set when the user commits. The field is busy while it runs, a newer edit of the field replaces a pending one (last wins; a stale completion changes nothing), an exception shows its message as the field's error with the typed text kept, and ModelChanged is raised only after it succeeds.

specMembers.name: Editor
specMembers.doc: Your own content in place of a control (an input with an inline action, a read-only summary): drawn in the field's body, in the element's editor-<key> slot. It has no value of its own, takes no part in the form or its validation, and Get/Set are never called; build it with Custom.

fieldFactories.name: Bool
fieldFactories.doc: A Checkbox spec over a bool property: wraps the string Get/Set so the caller does not translate "true"/"" by hand. Set the other members with with: PkFieldSpec<T>.Bool("active", "Active", o => o.Active, (o, v) => o.Active = v) with { Hint = "..." }.
fieldFactories.params: Func<TItem, bool> get, Action<TItem, bool> set

fieldFactories.name: Async
fieldFactories.doc: A spec whose change is committed by an async call (a service, a dependent reload): the element shows the field busy while it runs, a newer edit replaces a pending one (last wins, a stale answer changes nothing), an exception shows its message as the field's error and keeps the typed text, and ModelChanged is raised only after it succeeds. Get reads the model; the text goes to setAsync, not to Set.
fieldFactories.params: Func<TItem, string?> get, Func<TItem, string?, Task> setAsync

fieldFactories.name: Decimal
fieldFactories.doc: A number spec over a decimal? property: Min, Max and Step are decimals, and the value is read and written as invariant-culture text, so the model never sees the page's culture.
fieldFactories.params: Func<TItem, decimal?> get, Action<TItem, decimal?> set, decimal? min = null, decimal? max = null, decimal? step = null
init: Set = (item, v) => set(item, decimal.TryParse(v, System.Globalization.NumberStyles.Number, System.Globalization.CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, out var d) ? d : null)

fieldFactories.name: DateTime
fieldFactories.doc: A DateTime kind spec over a DateTime? property: the value is the wall-clock text yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm in invariant culture, with no time zone (a read-back value keeps its Kind, a committed one is DateTimeKind.Unspecified; convert in your own Get and Set when the property is UTC or a DateTimeOffset). Min and Max are DateTimes formatted the same way. An empty or unreadable text sets null.
fieldFactories.params: Func<TItem, System.DateTime?> get, Action<TItem, System.DateTime?> set, System.DateTime? min = null, System.DateTime? max = null
init: Set = (item, v) => set(item, System.DateTime.TryParseExact(v, new[] { "yyyy-MM-dd'T'HH:mm", "yyyy-MM-dd'T'HH:mm:ss" }, System.Globalization.CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, System.Globalization.DateTimeStyles.None, out var d) ? d : null)

fieldFactories.name: Custom
fieldFactories.doc: A spec that draws your own content (see Editor) instead of a control; it reads and writes nothing.

notes: PkFieldGroup<TItem> (Components/PkFieldGroup.razor) wraps pk-field-group 1:1: the controls, the conditional rendering, the form value and the validation are the element's. When, Disabled, ReadOnly, HelpWhen, LabelWhen and OptionsSource are read on every render and sent as data; LabelAction is slotted as label-action-<key>; Search is the element's search callback.
